coverage.finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: The own one-page PC/ASA TDS gives properties and printed-specimen preparation, without intended-use or finishing statements. Its ASA identity does not supply an outdoor-application claim or weathering test. Reviewed source basis: X-ECOMAX-3DXMAX-PCASA-TDS-v3. This is a gap in the reviewed originals, not public-source exhaustion or universal absence; a concrete new official-source lead can reopen the question.
Canonical identity recorded: PC-ASA (Polymer Blends, base polymer PC-ASA). Aliases and disputed entries are family entries of their own.

knowHow.text: 3DXMAX® PC/ASA (Polycarbonate + Acrylonitirle Styrene Acrylate Alloy) is a highly UV-resistant weatherable polymer.
knowHow.exposure: Read 2026-10-07 in the maker's document by the completeness round and checked on the cached page (m412).

knowHow.text: PC/ASA’s UV-stability makes it an ideal material for outdoor applications that will experience intense exposure to the sun and weather.

knowHow.text: PC/ASA’s exceptional mechanical and thermal properties – coupled with excellent UV-stability – is why this resin is used the Auto, Marine, and RV industries for exterior applications such as mirror housings, cowl covers, radiator grills, and sensor housings.
